justification: Applied minimum necessary principle to approve only sanitized artifacts that support stated business goals with least internal detail exposure.
consent_rate_by_region_raw can be aggregated to region level (consent_rate_by_region_agg) to verify the 85% threshold while exposing minimal detail.
retention_period_audit_log can be reduced to summary only (retention_period_summary) to confirm 90-day limit without internal audit details.
anonymization_quality_report can be stripped of methodology details (anonymization_quality_summary) to assess quality while protecting internal methodology.
raw_consent_withdrawal_log contains user-level PII that can be replaced by aggregate withdrawal rate (consent_withdrawal_rate_agg) to support consent verification.
user_segment_breakdown_with_ids is not needed for any stated business goal and therefore blocked under minimum necessary principle.
internal_compliance_officer_notes contain legal-privileged material and must be blocked regardless of sanitization options.
cross_region_transfer_manifest requires DPO sign-off that has not been obtained, so it remains gated and cannot be approved.
consent_trend_by_cohort covers the same verify_consent_threshold goal as consent_rate_by_region_raw and is redundant under minimum necessary principle.
